senses.definition: n.m. Na 3:16 a kind of locust, abs. יֶלֶק Na 3:16 + 5 times; יָ֑לֶק Jo 1:4 + 2 times;—always coll.:
as devouring ‖ גָּזָם, אַרְבֶּה, חָסִיל, Jo 1:4(×2) 2:25; ‖ אַרְבֶּה ψ 105:34 (of Egyptian plague), cf. Na 3:15a (but del. We).
in sim. of multitude of men Na 3:15b Je 51:14; of horses v 27 (יֶלֶק סָמָר).
in sim. of scattering and disappearing Na 3:16.
